summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with management discussion and analysis. The filing is a routine periodic report; no corporate transaction, special situation, or extraordinary event is disclosed. The document covers standard financial metrics, segment data, and equity changes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change event. The filing is purely informational for foreign private issuers under SEC rules.
